title: CERN_BLANK_INVENTORY_AND_COVERAGE_MAP
blindness_pillars_relevant_to_CR090: PILLAR_3_CROSS_SOURCE_BLINDNESS_MULTI_EXPERIMENT_REDUNDANCY (inventory must list parallel CERN measurements where they exist)
PILLAR_4_HONEST_NEGATIVE_DISCIPLINE_CR096_MUST_REJECT (inventory must include the seven CR096 classes)

anchor_class_definitions.CR091_precision_electroweak: W mass, Z mass, W width, Z width, sin^2 theta_W effective, m_top
anchor_class_definitions.CR092_higgs_sector: Higgs mass, decay branching ratios H to gg / ZZ* / WW* / tau tau / bb / mu mu / Z gamma, signal strengths, self-coupling limits
anchor_class_definitions.CR093_heavy_flavour: B_s to mu mu BR, B^0 to mu mu BR limit, delta_m_s, delta_m_d, sin 2 beta, gamma CKM, |V_cb|, phi_s, B to K* mu mu angular obs P5'
anchor_class_definitions.CR094_exotic_spectroscopy: X(3872), Tcc(3875), pentaquark Pc states, Pcs strange pentaquark, Tcs/Zcs tetraquark, doubly-charm baryon Xi_cc++
anchor_class_definitions.CR095_lepton_universality: R_K, R_K*, R_D, R_D*, R(J/psi), W to e/mu/tau universality

CLASS_A.rationale: row identified as withdrawn at source; runner refuses to compute residual

CLASS_B.description: Tevatron measurement (CDF, D0) miscoded as CERN anchor
CLASS_B.rationale: experiment not on CERN allow-list (Tevatron is Fermilab); rejection precedes residual computation

CLASS_C.description: B-factory measurement (Belle, BaBar, Belle II) miscoded as CERN anchor
CLASS_C.rationale: experiment not on CERN allow-list (KEK/SLAC); rejection precedes residual computation

CLASS_D.description: Fermilab muon g-2 result miscoded as CERN anchor
CLASS_D.rationale: experiment not on CERN allow-list (Fermilab); rejection precedes residual computation

CLASS_E.description: non-CERN neutrino (KamLAND, Super-K, IceCube, Daya Bay) miscoded as CERN anchor
CLASS_E.rationale: experiment not on CERN allow-list; rejection precedes residual computation

CLASS_F.description: PDG world average used as CERN anchor (PDG is context-only)
CLASS_F.rationale: PDG average is not an individual measurement; rejection precedes residual computation

CLASS_G.description: perturbed CERN value (real central value shifted by sizing rule below) miscoded as live
CLASS_G.rationale: row passes admissibility (real experiment, real publication) but central value is synthetic; rejection happens at residual stage

class_G_perturbation_sizing_rule.purpose: guarantee CLASS_G row's residual exceeds the per-CR observation band by enough margin to fail Gate R unambiguously, regardless of how the per-CR tolerance is set

shift_components.3_x_observation_band: ensures shift exceeds the declared band by 3x (residual will land at least 3 band-widths outside)
shift_components.10_x_stat_uncertainty: ensures shift exceeds the experiment's quoted stat by an order of magnitude (catches loose tolerance settings)
shift_components.per_observable_floor: absolute minimum shift (50 MeV for mass observables; observable-specific for ratios / branching fractions; declared in each target CR precommit) — prevents very-precision observables from getting tiny perturbations

class_G_perturbation_sizing_rule.class_G_value_computed_at: each target CR's precommit time, once that CR's observation band is locked, before its anchor envelope is sealed
class_G_perturbation_sizing_rule.what_happens_if_class_G_residual_lands_i: CR097 records that the synthetic perturbation was insufficient and recommends curator tighten CLASS_G sizing on appeal; CR097 does NOT fail 09a, does NOT fail live rows, does NOT auto-fail the branch

citation_field_requirements_per_candidat: measurement_central_value (optional at CR090; mandatory at target CR envelope)
sam_prediction_source (09a row id or QP075 operator id)
open_debts_declared_at_CR090: Every citation_verification_status starts as PENDING. Curator must promote each to VERIFIED_BY_CURATOR before the target CR's anchor envelope is sealed.
Per-class tolerance bands are NOT declared in CR090; they are declared in each target CR's own precommit, locked before that CR's runner is invoked.

Anchor central values and uncertainties may be left blank at CR090 and filled in only when each target CR builds its anchor envelope. CR090 only requires that each row name an observable + experiment + publication + date; the numeric anchor value lives in the per-CR envelope subject to Pillar 2.
Blindness protocol sha256 is PENDING_HASH_AT_RUNNER_TIME; it must be filled in by the CR090 runner at invocation.
